item.title: Senate deliberates, revises 2026 budget
item.description: On Jan. 12, the Undergraduate Student Senate (Senate) released a draft of its budget for the 2026 fiscal year. Senate shared the budget details in an email to undergraduates, which included a $4,500 increase, reduced spending on food provided during Senate meetings, and decreased compensation (honoraria) paid to its Executive Committee. item.title: CMU launches $55M AI initiative with Gates Foundation
item.description: The announcement comes after more than fifteen years of collaboration between the two institutions. On Jan. 29, Carnegie Mellon launched Learnvia, a nonprofit, AI-powered educational software that aims to improve outcomes at higher education institutions across the country.
